candidates.statement: Payment service calls from order time out (ReadTimeout, transport error) at ~2s, causing order and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502. Traces show payment POST /v1/authorizations erroring while inventory/redis succeed; checkout p95 ~2425ms and 502s dominate.
candidates.uncertainty: Payment-side metrics/logs not admitted; root cause within payment (latency vs saturation) unconfirmed.

report.explanation: Traces consistently show payment authorization ReadTimeout transport errors propagating to order and gateway 502s, while inventory/redis succeed. Gateway metrics show checkout 502s and elevated p95 latency. Bounded candidate: downstream payment latency.
